summary: Quiet residential kerb with parked cars, homes 14-18 m away on both sides.

best_section.where: Central Avenue west kerb, midway between the two ends, opposite the detached houses

drivers.seclusion: Apartments and houses line both sides within 14-18 m; no bush or open land to back onto.
drivers.access_and_room: Open street, parallel parking beside the lane where other cars sit. No gate on the road.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street near a school and roundabout; light through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb, so a van is less conspicuous. A bus zone sign sits near the 0 m end.

flags: Bus zone sign near the start; keep clear of it
Mapped dwellings within 25 m all round
School nearby so busy at drop-off times
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees overhang the east side and the kerb near 40-60 m, giving some afternoon shade.
